title: Maps on Tor are computed by lifts to projective resolutions
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $i\ge0$. For an $R$-module $M$ with a projective resolution $\cdots\to P_1\to P_0\xrightarrow{\varepsilon}M\to0$ (exact, $P_n$ projective) and an $R$-module $N$, let $\iota_{P,N}:\operatorname{Tor}^R_i(M,N)\xrightarrow{\sim}H_i(P_\bullet\otimes_RN)$ be the canonical isomorphism of [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. (1) Let $\varphi:M\to M'$ be $R$-linear, $\cdots\to P'_1\to P'_0\xrightarrow{\varepsilon'}M'\to0$ a projective resolution of $M'$ and $a:P_\bullet\to P'_\bullet$ a morphism of complexes with $\varepsilon'a_0=\varphi\varepsilon$. Then $\iota_{P',N}\circ\operatorname{Tor}^R_i(\varphi,N)=H_i(a\otimes1_N)\circ\iota_{P,N}$ for every $R$-module $N$. (2) Let $\psi:N\to N'$ be $R$-linear. Then $\iota_{P,N'}\circ\operatorname{Tor}^R_i(M,\psi)=H_i(1_{P_\bullet}\otimes\psi)\circ\iota_{P,N}$.
